back: Storing data on remote physical servers owned by a provider and reached over the internet.
Storing data on a device the user owns and controls, such as the computer's own drive or a flash drive.

front: Is cloud data stored on physical hardware?
back: Yes: on physical servers and storage devices in data centres.

front: Advantages of cloud storage over local storage?
back: Access from anywhere on any device, easy sharing, provider backups, storage easily increased, no hardware to maintain.
Needs an internet connection and data; security and privacy concerns; dependence on the provider; ongoing fees.
Works offline, fast access, user keeps full control, no subscription; but the user must back up and files stay on the device.
Using computing services (storage, software, processing) over the internet from remote servers.
Software as a service: apps in the browser. Platform as a service: platform for developers. Infrastructure as a service: rented virtual servers.
